source_artwork.review: Original two-sheeted hyperboloid and its projection plane; margin cropped to fit the prose.
Original doubly ruled surface and both families of rulings retained.

source_notes.note: Example 10.4 has d a_n as the last coordinate in L_a; expression retained.
Example 10.4 omits the separator between the ellipsis and the last zero in its light-source point. The original typography is preserved.
Exercise 10.2.4(a) writes X=V(...) ∈ projective space, and Exercise 10.2.6(a) gives the matrix dimensions and index ranges as printed. Retained without correction.
The paragraph following Proposition 10.20 omits minus one in the dimension of the ambient projective space. Retained as printed.
Exercise 10.3.3(b) omits e0 from the tuple on the right. Retained.
The paragraph after the first Segre map example gives m by n for the matrix arranged from (m+1)(n+1) entries. Retained.
The author calls 9.8 a Corollary but links to Proposition 9.8; both printed wording and verified target retained.
In Exercise 10.5.8(b) the set {3,4} appears in both cases of s(I), and {1,3} appears in neither. The two source cases are retained.
